rationale: Phase 2 of docs/native_vs_capture_8881_plan.md. Each entry assigns a mesh+slot to a capture-derived PNG because the OMT canvas chain in level1.omt does not resolve the slot (e.g. the material record has no Canv field). Every override must come from a measured drawcall in the capture stream -- not from heuristic dimension matching or PNG SHA-1 guessing.

overrides.notes:
GROUND material mid 0 has no Canv field in level1.omt so resolve_bitmap returns ''. The capture binds tex_05e10d68_128x128.png 133 times from a single WORLD matrix near the origin (one source mesh, many sub-triangles). The texture's mean colour matches the capture's bottom-third within ~3% per channel, confirming it is the ground tile.

SCHOOL-style multi-level meshes are NOT eligible for this override file -- see [[jn-school-multilevel]].
